newsitem.title: USA: Citicorp held deal talks with AmEx - CEO.
newsitem.headline: Citicorp held deal talks with AmEx - CEO.

text.p: Citicorp chief executive John Reed said on Wednesday that the company had held unfruitful merger talks with American Express Co.
"We did hold talks but nothing came of them," Reed told shareholders at Citicorp's annual meeting.

Rumors swirled several months ago that the two financial services groups were in preliminary discussions, but neither company had fully acknowledged the contacts. Citicorp declined comment at the time and American Express said it was no longer in talks.
Answering shareholder questions, Reed said Citicorp has no intention of trying to match the $1.7 billion acquisition of regional investment bank Alex. Brown Inc by Bankers Trust New York Corp.
The shareholder asked about the possibility of acquiring another regional brokerage, A.G Edwards & Sons.
"We have no such plans. I suspect it was a good move for Bankers Trust, but we have no such plans," Reed said.
